# Krishna Music School

> Krishna Music School teaches harmonium, Indian singing, bhajan and kirtan, Hindustani classical vocal and tabla. Classes are live and one-to-one, online worldwide or in person at the historic Rangji Temple in Pushkar, Rajasthan, India. Founded in 2008 by musician and teacher Vini Devda.

## Key facts

- Krishna Music School was founded in 2008 in Pushkar, Rajasthan, India, by Vini Devda (founder and lead teacher).
- Vini Devda is the third generation of a family of musicians and began learning Indian classical music at the age of five in the traditional guru–shishya way. Vini Devda holds a degree in Indian Classical Vocal Music from Government College, Ajmer, has taught students from 25+ countries since 2008, and leads the Chokhi Vini Project, the school's Rajasthani folk band.
- Online classes are live and one-to-one on Zoom or Google Meet, 40 minutes each, scheduled between 9:00 AM and 9:00 PM India time (IST, UTC+5:30), 7 days a week.
- In-person classes (60 minutes) and retreats take place at Rangji Temple, Pushkar, Rajasthan 305022, India.
- Teaching languages: English, Hindi. Students from age 8. Complete beginners are welcome.
- The school has taught 200+ students from 25+ countries.
- Reviews: 5.0/5 on TripAdvisor (55+ reviews); 4.9/5 on Google (61+ reviews), as of 2026-10.
- What every online class includes: Live one-to-one class on Zoom or Google Meet; Recording of every class to practise with; Notation and lyrics PDFs; WhatsApp support between classes; A practice routine made for your voice and schedule; Certificate of completion after 10 classes.
- Not happy after your first class? We refund it in full. Reschedule free of charge up to 4 hours before your class. 5-class packages are valid for 3 months and 10-class packages for 6 months.
- Payment: UPI or bank transfer (India), PayPal or Wise (international). Prices are set in Indian rupees (INR).
- Contact: WhatsApp or phone +91 99286 58520, email krishnamusicschoolpushkar@gmail.com. We usually reply on WhatsApp within 2–4 hours (9 AM – 9 PM IST).
- The school's performing wing, the Chokhi Vini Project, plays Rajasthani folk, Sufi, devotional and fusion music for weddings, hotels, festivals and corporate events.

## Online classes

- [All online classes](https://krishnamusicschool.com/online-classes/): Overview, how online classes work, prices and FAQs.
- [Online Harmonium Classes](https://krishnamusicschool.com/online-classes/harmonium/): Live one-to-one harmonium classes on Zoom or Google Meet with Vini Devda, for complete beginners, yoga teachers and kirtan leaders. Within 10 classes most students can play and sing 4–5 bhajans or kirtans with confidence. Each online class lasts 40 minutes; a single class costs ₹1,500 (≈ US$17) and 10 classes cost ₹13,500 (≈ US$153). Prices — Single class: ₹1,500 (≈ US$17); 5 classes: ₹6,500 (≈ US$74); 10 classes: ₹13,500 (≈ US$153).
- [Online Indian Singing Classes](https://krishnamusicschool.com/online-classes/singing/): Live one-to-one Indian singing lessons on Zoom or Google Meet with Vini Devda, rooted in Hindustani classical training. Ideal if you believe you cannot sing, and just as useful for experienced singers who want raga, bhajan and kirtan technique. Each online class lasts 40 minutes; a single class costs ₹1,500 (≈ US$17) and 10 classes cost ₹13,500 (≈ US$153). Prices — Single class: ₹1,500 (≈ US$17); 5 classes: ₹6,500 (≈ US$74); 10 classes: ₹13,500 (≈ US$153).
- [Online Bhajan & Kirtan Classes](https://krishnamusicschool.com/online-classes/bhajan-kirtan/): Live one-to-one bhajan and kirtan classes on Zoom or Google Meet with Vini Devda, for yoga teachers, kirtan leaders and spiritual seekers. You learn traditional bhajans and mantras, how to lead call-and-response kirtan, correct Sanskrit pronunciation and simple harmonium accompaniment. The 5-class kirtan track costs ₹6,500 (≈ US$74); single classes cost ₹1,500 (≈ US$17). Prices — Single class: ₹1,500 (≈ US$17); 5 classes: ₹6,500 (≈ US$74).
- [Online Indian Classical Vocal Classes (Raga & Khayal)](https://krishnamusicschool.com/online-classes/indian-classical-vocal/): Long-term, one-to-one Hindustani classical vocal training on Zoom or Google Meet with Vini Devda: from voice culture and your first ragas to khayal with alaap, bandish and taan. Taught in the traditional guru–shishya way and adapted for students anywhere in the world. Classes cost ₹1,500 (≈ US$17) each; long-term programmes are planned with you. Prices — Single class: ₹1,500 (≈ US$17); Long-term programmes are planned and priced with you.
- [Online Tabla Classes](https://krishnamusicschool.com/online-classes/tabla/): Live one-to-one tabla lessons on Zoom or Google Meet with Vini Devda, whose main instrument is tabla; most of the school's TripAdvisor reviews come from tabla students. You start with hand position and the basic bols, then learn thekas such as Teentaal and Keharwa and your first compositions. Each online class lasts 40 minutes; a single class costs ₹1,500 (≈ US$17). Prices — Single class: ₹1,500 (≈ US$17); 5 classes: ₹6,500 (≈ US$74); 10 classes: ₹13,500 (≈ US$153).

Upcoming dates: 11–18 Nov 2026; 11–18 Dec 2026; 11–18 Jan 2027; 11–18 Feb 2027. Price: ₹30,000 per person.

- [Folk Music Band](https://krishnamusicschool.com/folk-music-band-chokhi-vini-project-pushkar/): Authentic Rajasthani folk with traditional instruments. 5–10 piece ensemble. From ₹80,000.

- [Sufi Musical Experience](https://krishnamusicschool.com/kabali-sufi-musical-experience/): A mystical Sufi performance and spiritual journey. From ₹50,000.
- [Dinner Concerts](https://krishnamusicschool.com/dinner-concerts-private-music-evenings/): Intimate musical evenings for private gatherings. From ₹40,000.
- [Fusion Instrumental](https://krishnamusicschool.com/fusion-instrumental-groups/): Indian and Western instruments together. Contemporary and refined. From ₹70,000.
